newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia palm oil ends off lows, bearish data.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia palm oil ends off lows, bearish data.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices closed off lows on covering at lower levels. A bearish crop report by Ivan Wong prompted selling in early afternoon trading. Dealing was volatile with lack of fresh export news also dampening sentiment. Dec futures fell to 1,122 but rebounded thereafter.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL -Interest was seen among RBD palm oil and olein, with talk Indonesia demand also helping late sentiment.

Wong estimated end-Sept palm oil stocks at 910,000 tonnes, compared with the Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority's (PORLA) 800,893 tonnes at end-August. He said palm oil exports in September were projected to be 655,000 tonnes from PORLA's 638,601 tonnes.

"Covering emerged at lower levels as prices have fallen a lot in recent days. And prices rebounded thereafter," a dealer said. At the close, only marginal falls were seen in most futures contracts, they said.
December futures ended four ringgit down at 1,133 ringgit ($452.84) a tonne after trading in the range of 1,122 and 1,137.
Traders said the next support level is 1,120 ringgit.
Trading was volatile with volume on the futures market totalling 1,929 lots against 1,554 on Friday.
Traders said initial weak sentiment was affected by lack of keen export business. "There weren't any tenders from India or Pakistan yet," a dealer said.

Physicals saw selective trading with talk that Indonesia was in the local market helping late sentiment. Sept (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,160 ringgit a tonne after trading from 1,160 to 1,150. Sept (south) saw bids at 1,150. Sept (central) was offered at 1,145 with bids at 1,135.
Oct (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,160 ringgit with bids at 1,150. Oct (central) saw offers at 1,145 and bids at 1,135 and Nov (south) at 1,170 with bids at 1,160.
In refined products, Oct RBD palm oil was offered at $495 a tonne FOB Malaysia and Nov/Dec at $495.

Last-half Oct palm olein saw offers at $530, Nov/Dec at $525 and Jan/Feb/Mch at $527.50. Nov was traded at $520 and Dec at $522.50. Sept/Oct RBD palm stearin was offered at $397.50, Nov at $400 and Sept/Oct/Nov palm fatty acid distillate at $335. - Tan Lee Lee (603-2308911) ($1=2.5020 ringgit).
